lines.text: Your backend servers are fast.
lines.caption: Your backend servers are fast.

lines.text: A typical request takes ten milliseconds.
lines.caption: A typical request takes ten milliseconds.

lines.text: But about one request in a hundred hits a hiccup, and takes a full second.
lines.caption: But about one request in a hundred hits a hiccup, and takes a full second.

lines.text: One slow request in a hundred sounds rare enough to live with.
lines.caption: One slow request in a hundred sounds rare enough to live with.

lines.text: Now a user's page calls a hundred of these servers at once, and waits until every one has answered.
lines.caption: Now a user's page calls a hundred of these servers at once, and waits until every one has answered.

lines.text: How often is the page slow?
lines.caption: How often is the page slow?

segments.title: One in a hundred, a hundred times

lines.text: The page is fast only if all hundred calls are fast.
lines.caption: The page is fast only if all hundred calls are fast.

lines.text: Each call is fast ninety-nine times out of a hundred.
lines.caption: Each call is fast ninety-nine times out of a hundred.

lines.text: Assume the hiccups are independent: one server hitting a hiccup doesn't make another more likely to.
lines.caption: Assume the hiccups are independent: one server hitting a hiccup doesn't make another more likely to.

lines.text: Then the hundred calls are like a hundred separate coin flips, each coin weighted to come up fast ninety-nine times in a hundred.
lines.caption: Then the hundred calls are like a hundred separate coin flips, each coin weighted to come up fast ninety-nine times in a hundred.

lines.text: The chance that all hundred come up fast is ninety-nine percent, times ninety-nine percent, a hundred times over.
lines.caption: The chance that all hundred come up fast is ninety-nine percent, times ninety-nine percent, a hundred times over.

lines.text: That comes to about thirty-seven percent.
lines.caption: That comes to about thirty-seven percent.

lines.text: So sixty-three percent of pages wait at least a second.
lines.caption: So sixty-three percent of pages wait at least a second.

lines.text: For one server, a slow call was the rare case.
lines.caption: For one server, a slow call was the rare case.

lines.text: For the page, it's the usual case.
lines.caption: For the page, it's the usual case.

lines.text: A dashboard of each server's average response time wouldn't warn you.
lines.caption: A dashboard of each server's average response time wouldn't warn you.

lines.text: Ninety-nine calls at ten milliseconds and one at a second average out to about twenty milliseconds, which looks healthy.
lines.caption: Ninety-nine calls at ten milliseconds and one at a second average out to about twenty milliseconds, which looks healthy.

lines.text: The slow calls show up in the percentiles.
lines.caption: The slow calls show up in the percentiles.

lines.text: The ninety-ninth percentile is the time that ninety-nine percent of calls finish within.
lines.caption: The ninety-ninth percentile is the time that ninety-nine percent of calls finish within.

lines.text: For these servers, it's about a second.
lines.caption: For these servers, it's about a second.

lines.text: Those rare, slow calls make up the long tail of each server's latency distribution.
lines.caption: Those rare, slow calls make up the long tail of each server's latency distribution.

lines.text: That's why this is called tail latency.
lines.caption: That's why this is called tail latency.

lines.text: Most pages that wait on a hundred servers include a call from their slowest one percent.
lines.caption: Most pages that wait on a hundred servers include a call from their slowest one percent.

lines.text: So with a hundred calls, the typical page is as slow as the servers' ninety-ninth percentile, not their average.
lines.caption: So with a hundred calls, the typical page is as slow as the servers' ninety-ninth percentile, not their average.

lines.text: With more calls per page, an even rarer, slower percentile decides.
lines.caption: With more calls per page, an even rarer, slower percentile decides.

lines.text: Turn that around.
lines.caption: Turn that around.

lines.text: For the page itself to be slow only one time in a hundred, each of its hundred servers would have to be slow only one time in ten thousand.
lines.caption: For the page itself to be slow only one time in a hundred, each of its hundred servers would have to be slow only one time in ten thousand.

segments.title: Why not fix the slow calls?

lines.text: Why not just find the slow one percent and fix it?
lines.caption: Why not just find the slow one percent and fix it?

lines.text: Because hiccups have many causes, and most are brief.
lines.caption: Because hiccups have many causes, and most are brief.

lines.text: A burst of traffic builds a queue.
lines.caption: A burst of traffic builds a queue.

lines.text: A garbage collector pauses the program.
lines.caption: A garbage collector pauses the program.

lines.text: A background job, or another program on the same machine, borrows the disk or the processor for a moment.
lines.caption: A background job, or another program on the same machine, borrows the disk or the processor for a moment.

lines.text: Each one is short, and lands on whichever calls happen to be running.
lines.caption: Each one is short, and lands on whichever calls happen to be running.

lines.text: You can remove some causes and make hiccups rarer, but in a large system you can't make them all go away.
lines.caption: You can remove some causes and make hiccups rarer, but in a large system you can't make them all go away.

lines.text: So large systems are built to tolerate them, the way they tolerate machines that fail.
lines.caption: So large systems are built to tolerate them, the way they tolerate machines that fail.

lines.text: One standard technique is the hedged request.
lines.caption: One standard technique is the hedged request.

lines.text: Send the call to one server.
lines.caption: Send the call to one server.

lines.text: If it hasn't answered by the ninety-fifth percentile, the time that ninety-five percent of calls finish within, send a copy to a second server that holds the same data.
lines.caption: If it hasn't answered by the ninety-fifth percentile, the time that ninety-five percent of calls finish within, send a copy to a second server that holds the same data.

lines.text: Use whichever answer comes back first.
lines.caption: Use whichever answer comes back first.

lines.text: A call that hit a hiccup is usually rescued by the copy, as long as the two servers don't hit a hiccup at the same moment.
lines.caption: A call that hit a hiccup is usually rescued by the copy, as long as the two servers don't hit a hiccup at the same moment.

lines.text: So the copy goes to a server on a different machine, where the same hiccup is unlikely to reach it.
lines.caption: So the copy goes to a server on a different machine, where the same hiccup is unlikely to reach it.

lines.text: The cost is small.
lines.caption: The cost is small.

lines.text: Only calls slower than the ninety-fifth percentile get a copy, so the servers see about five percent more requests.
lines.caption: Only calls slower than the ninety-fifth percentile get a copy, so the servers see about five percent more requests.

lines.text: In our simulation, hedging cut the share of slow pages from sixty-three percent to about one percent.
lines.caption: In our simulation, hedging cut the share of slow pages from sixty-three percent to about one percent.

lines.text: Google measured hedging on a real system.
lines.caption: Google measured hedging on a real system.

lines.text: In one benchmark, each request read a thousand values from a hundred servers.
lines.caption: In one benchmark, each request read a thousand values from a hundred servers.

lines.text: Across many of these requests, hedging after a fixed ten milliseconds cut the ninety-nine point nine percentile, the time that 99.9 percent of them finish within, from one point eight seconds to seventy-four milliseconds.
lines.caption: Across many of these requests, hedging after a fixed ten milliseconds cut the 99.9th percentile, the time that 99.9 percent of them finish within, from 1.8 seconds to 74 milliseconds.

lines.text: It cost only two percent more requests.
lines.caption: It cost only two percent more requests.

lines.text: But hedge too early, and every call gets a copy.
lines.caption: But hedge too early, and every call gets a copy.

lines.text: That's twice the load, and more load means longer queues, so busier servers answer more slowly.
lines.caption: That's twice the load, and more load means longer queues, so busier servers answer more slowly.

lines.text: Waiting for the ninety-fifth percentile keeps the extra load small.
lines.caption: Waiting for the ninety-fifth percentile keeps the extra load small.

lines.text: Hedging suits reads.
lines.caption: Hedging suits reads.

lines.text: A copy of a write, like a payment, could happen twice, and making that safe is the next lesson.
lines.caption: A copy of a write, like a payment, could happen twice, and making that safe is the next lesson.

lines.text: So the page was slow sixty-three percent of the time because it waited on a hundred servers, and a one-in-a-hundred hiccup is more likely than not to hit at least one of them.
lines.caption: So the page was slow sixty-three percent of the time because it waited on a hundred servers, and a one-in-a-hundred hiccup is more likely than not to hit at least one of them.

lines.text: When a request fans out, watch your servers' ninety-ninth percentile, their tail latency, not their average.
lines.caption: When a request fans out, watch your servers' ninety-ninth percentile, their tail latency, not their average.

lines.text: And instead of hunting every hiccup, design the fan-out to tolerate them.
lines.caption: And instead of hunting every hiccup, design the fan-out to tolerate them.

lines.text: All of this assumes the hiccups are independent.
lines.caption: All of this assumes the hiccups are independent.

lines.text: When one cause hits many servers at once, like a network blip, the arithmetic changes, and a hedge's copy may be slow too.
lines.caption: When one cause hits many servers at once, like a network blip, the arithmetic changes, and a hedge's copy may be slow too.
